question.text: RBI as the manager of Foreign Exchange administers:

explanation.text: The Logic: The Reserve Bank of India, as the manager of Foreign Exchange, administers the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999. The Trap: RBI's foreign exchange management role sits under FEMA — not the Companies Act, SCRA, or the Income Tax Act. Note: FEMA is the legislative framework under which RBI exercises its forex management powers.
